Make the craft medium the foundation: broad, gently curving bands of canal water emerge from fine, hand-gouged lines, delicate scraped and incised botanical curls, and warm matte gourd-shell-like grain. The channels, curls and double-curved decorative rhythms should flow into one another as a continuous surface, not be a small icon pasted on a generic landscape. A rich honey-amber, tobacco, warm umber and restrained ink-black palette, with tiny touches of muted jade if useful. The result should feel like an original handmade Chinese decorative print and carved surface, with fine irregular tool marks and quiet cultural depth.
Composition: A long, elegant diagonal river-like sweep crosses the upper right and flows along one edge; the opposing left-center offers an uncluttered warm matte tonal field suitable for later dark text or a gentle overlay. Make the mobile-center crop readable and keep the bottom airy rather than filling it with decoration. Asymmetrical and visually different in color and construction from an indigo fishing-net textile image; not a conventional mountains-and-waves composition. Wide horizontal 16:9, highest clear native resolution available.
Constraints: Imaginative AI-created illustration only, not a photograph or historical representation.
